speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing increasing pain and swelling in his right knee for the past 12 days. He reports pain with urination for the past 3 weeks and had a swollen, painful left ankle joint that resolved on its own about a week ago. speaker: Doctor
text: The pattern of a previous swollen ankle, now a swollen knee, combined with urinary pain and a history of inconsistent condom use is highly suggestive of Reactive Arthritis. Can you tell me if you have had any recent diarrhea or throat infections, and do you notice any eye pain or changes in vision?
